caveats: Diagnostic timings are not performance evidence.
Thread grid has only 3 repetitions; contaminated full groups excluded; exploratory negative result only.
Formal comparisons use the first qualified full 30-run case group, never the fastest run.
Original eigenpair residual, rank and exact inertia certificate remain active. Internal acceptance retains 1e-12 and falls back to long double.
v1 numeric checks passed but implicit FMA contraction did not match the proof. v2 disables contraction in the enclosure function; v3 also checks each worker mode.

v3 initial boundary harness omitted omp.h. The next harness expected worker FP modes to persist across OpenMP regions; a probe proved libgomp resets them. Final harness verifies the observed reset and preserves caller controls. This is not coverage of an abnormal mode inside a persistent worker.
Enclosure counters are cumulative per backend. Counter estimates may undercount consecutive backends with nondecreasing counters; raw sequences are authoritative.
Parent phase times include inner sector work; parent factor counters alone do not.
Two photonic inputs have incomplete external spectrum references.
Solver never densifies sparse matrices; full dense oracles are limited to small test inputs.
Periodic process sampling cannot prove exclusive physical ownership or capture every short-lived or migrating thread.
Private candidates require P29 and frozen P33-P39 dependencies; production P29 unchanged.
